purpose: Test whether moderate score-network capacity, rather than an antagonistic conditional-mean proxy objective, is the remaining limitation after V22 and V23.

intervening_negative_result.finding: The V23 conditional loss had 0.624 mean gradient-norm ratio and -0.387 mean cosine versus the V22 base objective; it improved its denoising proxy but degraded all Q3/Q4 results.

single_change.description: Return exactly to the V22 objective/protocol and increase ObservableContextUNet base_channels from 32 to 48.

explicitly_removed_from_v23.reason: V23 established that this proxy supplies a large antagonistic gradient and worsens field metrics. V24 is a capacity test against the V22 baseline, not a two-factor capacity-plus-penalty experiment.

inherited_byte_identical_from_v22: optimizer, learning rates, gradient clip, EMA, and 30000-step cosine schedule
field evaluator, Q3/Q4/Q5 definitions, and thresholds

diagnostics_and_selection.selection: smallest candidate passing every unchanged V6 field check plus Q3 and Q4 independently in all three domains
diagnostics_and_selection.Q6: residual and forward-mapped latent conditional mean/std profiles at all candidates; selection_role none
diagnostics_and_selection.swift_no_harm: Swift must retain the unchanged field gate and Q3/Q4 pass at the selected candidate
capacity_diagnostics: parameter count and peak CUDA memory
V22-to-V24 Q3/Q4/Q6 changes at every frozen candidate

failure_classification_at_step_30000.next: seal V24 and await explicit approval before independent-data access

failure_classification_at_step_30000.condition: no all-domain pass and balanced validation improves by less than 1 percent from step 25000 to 30000
failure_classification_at_step_30000.next: stop capacity scaling and design a sampler-aligned or alternative generative objective

failure_classification_at_step_30000.condition: no all-domain pass without the frozen plateau condition
failure_classification_at_step_30000.next: audit optimization and candidate trajectories without extending or tuning

fixed_decision_order: implement and test only the base_channels change against V22
run a sealed Lageunha Ada preflight
train one model from scratch with no mid-run changes
otherwise apply the frozen failure classification and stop with Astrid unopened
never increase capacity again, alter thresholds, extend the horizon, or add V23 loss after seeing V24 results

approval_firewall.Astrid_access: forbidden until development pass, committed seal, and explicit user approval
